post.description: Answers a question or request inside a saved conversation. Numbers come from deterministic calculations, and model wording carries figure tokens that the server fills in and checks. Answers link the household records behind them, name the result field behind each figure and carry an evidence confidence level. Unrelated requests get a fixed reply without a model call. Requested changes come back as proposals that need confirmation. Rate limited per user and by assistant capacity.
